dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: Hmm? You speak to Starsnatcher, Celestial Lord...

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: ...Well, a follower of his, at any rate. What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: Familiar, isn't it? I picked it up below the inn. I suppose that it must be the one that Lord Starsnatcher always wore.

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: But this has to be a spare. I can't imagine that Lord Starsnatcher would just leave his mask behind...

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: What sin must we have committed for us to be abandoned by Lord Starsnatcher? Come to think of it, I have not seen His Lordship in many days...

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: How dare you slander Lord Starsnatcher in the presence of his followers? You, you...

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: ...Hmph. A follower of an adeptus must not swear. What's more, I am wearing His Lordship's mask.

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: Leave. Leave now. I do not wish to speak to you. Aye, you must be a fake yourself, you fake!

dialogues.speaker: Master of Stars
dialogues.text: Oh, are you a follower of Lord Starsnatcher as well? If you should ever have the good fortune to see him again, please tell me.
